description: Gets information about Sitecore caches, with their size and occupancy. Omit name to return every cache. Cache names contain square brackets ('master[items]'); pass one exactly as reported and it is matched literally, or use * / ? for a wildcard.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

name.description: The name of the cache to retrieve, e.g. 'master[items]'. Use * or ? for wildcard matching. If not provided, all caches will be returned.

name: common-get-cache
